finalText:
**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.**

All files pass `node --check`. No tests exist in the repo to run.

Two calls remain in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). I left them alone. The file carries a `Do not edit` banner. It gets replaced wholesale on upgrade.

`cache.query` is a different object. Untouched.

Next: decide the vendor path. Either pin an upgrade or wrap the adapter.
